text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mejiro 
Ryan, as we were passing by a park—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ryan-san! Just in time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, pretty please? Come help Falco 
out~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Help out with... what exactly?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's obviously... fan! ser! vice! ☆

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, big sis, what're you gonna do for me 
today~?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: I want to hear a new song~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fan service...? Hehe, so that's what these 
kids are to you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~! This'll totally fire 
Ryan-san up too☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... but what on earth am I supposed to 
do—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course, when you think of Umadols... 
you think of live concerts! I want to show 
these girls a song with a two-person 
choreography♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's all for the smiles of these little 
ones! Pleeease, Ryan-san☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. To smile, huh? Yeah, that's 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Guess I'll lend a helping hand 
too, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even so... songs like the ones Falco 
dances to are a little embarrassing for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's okay~! I know you can make it look 
cute, Ryan-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Let's get a few words of advice 
from your Trainer too! ☆
choice_data_list:
I'll just think of it as strength 
training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it looks like I'll be fine! 
I'll give it a shot... with the power of 
muscle!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-That's... not really cute at all—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: What's that?! That sounds kinda fun~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway! Music... start☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, one, two, one, two... Lovely and 
cute—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Lovely and cute, nice muscles! Look over 
here, nice bulk!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: "That looks fun! Hey, hey, can I try too?"

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: "Nice muscle! Nice buuuulk~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Muscles treat everyone equally, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Th-That's not what I meant at aaaaall!

Under the dazzling sun, the four of them 
worked up a refreshing sweat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-To be cute...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's a little embarrassing, but I'll do 
my best...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! In that case, just leave it to 
Falco♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I'll teach you a cute and 
lovely song that's just perfect for you, 
Ryan-san☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Cute and lovely... !?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm curious... wait no, this is honestly 
kind of embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right? Everyone wants to see a super-duper 
cute song too, don't they~?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! I wanna see something cute!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text: I wonder what it's like~? Can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
P-Put that way, it makes sense... But 
still... Nnnngh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! Go, go, Ryan♪ Pretty Ryan♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
T-Turning my toes in like this...! No, if 
I just think of it as some kind of 
training...!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you're so cute~! Adorable~! 
Pretty!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: E-Eh!? Ehehe, y-you think so...!

Mejiro Ryan and the others' cute live 
performance was a huge hit with their 
younger fans.
